observed_failure_source.failure_signature: deterministic RgLive Evidence relevance-to-sufficiency promotion failure

first_exact_condition.condition: After search-root containment, at least one usable ASCII token, rg exit 0 or 1, at least one parsed C# lexical match, optional exact-filename uniqueness/match, and UTF-8 decode of the single ranked file, collect constructs exactly one EvidenceItem and unconditionally returns readiness=sufficient and can_generate_patch=true.

responsible_owner.why: This is the first component that converts an authentic lexical observation into sufficient patch authority. Later planning and binding preserve the supplied identity but do not create the relevance claim.

flow: _query_tokens extracts unique ASCII tokens, removes a small stop-word set, and truncates to 12
rg performs a case-insensitive OR search over C# files with max-count 80
_select_file ranks total token occurrences, match count, then path, and returns one file/line

sufficiency_and_authority.readiness_sufficient_condition: successful construction of one selected lexical excerpt; no separate readiness evaluator runs
sufficiency_and_authority.can_generate_patch_condition: the same successful branch sets true directly
sufficiency_and_authority.authoritative_for_patch_formation: EvidencePack.to_artifact_payload sets authoritative_for_patch equal to can_generate_patch
sufficiency_and_authority.pack_authority_formation: EvidencePack.to_artifact_payload always emits mod_agent_deterministic_evidence for a structurally valid pack
sufficiency_and_authority.item_authority_formation: RgLiveEvidenceProvider creates the selected item with mod_agent_deterministic authority and byte hashes

feature_spec_consumption.physical_reason: The Graph passes feature_data into evidence_factory, but run_local_request names that parameter underscore and builds the query only from state.user_request.

representation_and_information_loss.source_authenticity: preserved by source path, exact byte hash, excerpt, span, symbol, and deterministic item authority
representation_and_information_loss.lexical_relevance: preserved only as token occurrence and the free-text claim that source contains request terms
representation_and_information_loss.semantic_sufficiency: not represented or checked in the basic RgLive pack
representation_and_information_loss.edit_authority: derived downstream from target_source item identity after can_generate_patch already became true
representation_and_information_loss.field_coupling: can_generate_patch simultaneously controls Artifact authoritative_for_patch, so retrieval success and semantic patch authority are conflated
representation_and_information_loss.positive_vs_preservation_intent: not distinguished; all retained tokens participate in one OR search and one occurrence ranking
representation_and_information_loss.multi_file_or_multi_fact_coverage: not supported by collect; it returns one selected path, one line neighborhood, and one item
representation_and_information_loss.feature_spec_information_loss: Existing fields are natural-language arrays without stable obligation identities or EvidenceItem-to-obligation references. They cannot mechanically prove that configuration creation, spread override control, true-path preservation, and independent-setting preservation are all covered.
representation_and_information_loss.existing_basic_evidence_pack_information: EvidenceItem.claim_supported is free text and carries no requirement_ids or relationship disposition; basic strict rehydrate checks shape/identity, not request coverage.

actual_failure_mechanism.explanation: The Chinese request is not split by requested_scope_text's English without/do-not rules. The first 12 ASCII tokens include follow, recoil, first, and shot. Raw occurrence scoring can therefore select preservation-related first-shot code instead of configuration and spread-size control evidence.

observed_result.claim_supported: Live source contains request terms near SetStoredCrosshair.

direct_consumers.effect: commits the RgLive pack through the existing Graph
requires sufficient, can_generate_patch, pack authority, item authority/provenance, then turns every editable target_source item into an edit binding
verify binding-to-Evidence path/symbol/span identity but do not re-evaluate request relevance
inherits the edit-binding scope and therefore cannot recover an omitted file without new Evidence

existing_tests_depending_on_current_beha.regression_risk: Changing every lexical hit to partial will alter direct RgLive success tests and every local ProductExecution path. Binding/Proposal/Apply tests should remain unchanged when a pack has already passed the new sufficiency owner.

reusable_mechanisms: request-side Requirement Projection with stable requirement/relation identity
family-specific Search Plan query_families and evidence_need
_source_query_inputs provenance labels for family queries, engineering questions, natural request, behavior goal, and trigger
real source retriever plumbing tests that prove a model-proposed technical lead reaches a source symbol
existing_search_planning_reuse.minimal_reuse_boundary: Reuse the existing request-obligation/query-family identities and deterministic lead normalization as inputs to the existing source-only retrieval path. Do not import the whole metadata/IL Specialist loop into ProductExecution and do not add Dense, RRF, reranking, a second Graph, or a second EvidencePack contract.
existing_search_planning_reuse.not_yet_lossless: ProductExecution FeatureSpec does not currently carry the relation identities consumed by the Discovery contract. Bridging that representation is P1 and must not be hidden inside the P0 sufficiency fix.

minimum_correction_boundary.p0_change: Separate authentic lexical observations from semantic patch authority. A lexical hit may remain a hashed EvidenceItem, but cannot alone set sufficient/can_generate_patch/authoritative_for_patch. Fail closed when explicit request obligations are not bound to Evidence.
minimum_correction_boundary.p1_followup: Use existing Search Planning obligation/query-family representation to improve source recall without adding a retrieval system. Keep technical leads non-authoritative until current source observations satisfy coverage.
likely_touched_production_boundaries_if_: the existing run_local_request evidence_factory handoff in src/mod_agent/local_entry.py
must_not_modify: model, Prompt, context, provider, Repair budget
Dense, RRF, reranking, or the general RAG system

negative: A multi-obligation config/behavior/preservation request with hits only in preservation-related code remains non-authoritative and cannot reach ImplementationPlan.
One lexical hit cannot satisfy multiple explicit Evidence obligations.
Valid source hashes and target_source authority do not substitute for semantic coverage.
Preservation/invariant terms cannot outrank the positive change obligation and independently grant sufficiency.
A request requiring facts from multiple files fails closed when only one file is observed.
An exact user-supplied filename still proves only that file's lexical/source identity unless all request obligations are covered.
positive: A single-obligation, one-file request with an explicit bound observation remains sufficient and produces the same binding identity.
A multi-file request becomes sufficient only when every explicit obligation has a bound current-source observation.
ImplementationPlanner and BindingResolver continue to accept a pack after the sufficiency owner has admitted it.
adjacent_regression: ProductExecution early blocked route and same-StateGraph tests

priority_route.P0: Fix Evidence false sufficiency and patch-authority admission in the physical owner.
priority_route.P1: Improve Retrieval recall with the smallest existing Search Planning bridge; keep all leads non-authoritative until observed.
priority_route.P2: Form a code checkpoint, rebuild a sealed packet, run one separately authorized fresh actual, then require Patch/Build/Repair/Revalidation evidence.
priority_route.P3: Address Runtime delivery, cross-task generality, repeated stability, Operational Readiness, three-to-five real tasks, and later statistical Eval.
priority_route.coverage_statement: The current four-step path—owner correction, checkpoint, sealed fresh actual, and Patch/Build/Repair/Revalidation—covers P0 and parts of P1/P2 only. The route is not complete until P3 evidence is separately produced.

ready_scope: P0 Evidence relevance-to-sufficiency separation plus focused negative/positive tests; P1 representation bridge requires its own explicit boundary if P0 exposes the documented FeatureSpec information loss.
next_action: Await user authorization for the bounded P0 owner correction; do not rerun AccurateCrosshair automatically.
